events.title: El Salvador changes Bitcoin legal-tender requirements under an IMF-backed program
events.summary: El Salvador's legislature approved amendments to the Bitcoin Law that removed mandatory acceptance and other essential legal-tender features, making private-sector Bitcoin acceptance voluntary as part of reforms linked to an IMF-supported program.
events.significance: The amendment materially scaled back the compulsory elements of the world's first national Bitcoin legal-tender regime while leaving Bitcoin lawful to use.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador EFF Staff Report
Reuters — El Salvador lawmakers reform Bitcoin law

events.title: Bybit heist
events.summary: Attackers stole approximately $1.5 billion in virtual assets from Bybit after compromising a signing workflow associated with an external multisignature service.
events.significance: The incident became the largest publicly reported crypto theft to that point and a defining modern exchange-security failure.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

events.title: Lazarus Group attribution becomes central to Bybit investigation
events.summary: The FBI publicly attributed the Bybit theft to North Korea, calling the activity TraderTraitor and warning that the stolen assets were being rapidly converted and dispersed across blockchains.
events.significance: The attribution made the heist a major state-linked cybercrime event and reinforced North Korea's central role in crypto theft.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

events.title: US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve established
events.summary: A US executive order established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve capitalized initially with finally forfeited government BTC and directed that Bitcoin deposited into the reserve not be sold.
events.significance: The policy transformed confiscated Bitcoin from an asset normally disposed of by government into a formally designated reserve category.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order
White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Fact Sheet

events.title: US banking regulators roll back several crypto-specific supervisory hurdles
events.summary: US banking regulators rolled back several earlier crypto-specific supervisory hurdles: the OCC removed its prior non-objection process on March 7, the FDIC rescinded its prior-notification requirement on March 28, and the Federal Reserve withdrew earlier crypto and dollar-token guidance on April 24.
events.significance: The sequence materially changed the regulatory posture for banks considering permissible crypto custody, stablecoin and distributed-ledger activities.

sources.title: OCC — Clarifies Bank Authority for Crypto Activities
FDIC — Banks May Engage in Permissible Crypto Activities Without Prior Approval

events.title: Tokenized Treasury funds exceed major market milestones
events.summary: BlackRock's tokenized BUIDL fund surpassed $1 billion in assets under management.
events.significance: The milestone was a major proof point that public-blockchain tokenized Treasury/cash products had moved from experiment to billion-dollar institutional scale.

events.title: Ethereum Pectra upgrade
events.summary: Ethereum activated the Prague-Electra (Pectra) upgrade at epoch 364,032.
events.significance: Pectra combined major validator, wallet and Layer-2-scaling improvements and was Ethereum's largest bundle of EIPs to that point.

events.title: Stablecoin legislation becomes a major US federal policy milestone
events.summary: The US President signed S. 1582, the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act), into law.
events.significance: The law created a federal statutory framework for payment stablecoins, marking a major shift from agency-led enforcement and state-by-state rules toward national legislation.

sources.title: White House — GENIUS Act Signed Into Law

events.title: Ethereum Fusaka upgrade
events.summary: Ethereum activated the Fulu-Osaka (Fusaka) upgrade at epoch 411,392.
events.significance: Fusaka advanced Ethereum's data-availability and Layer-2 scaling roadmap while also increasing Layer-1 performance capacity.
